### ebay_assistant
Mobile-first React + TypeScript UI for browsing your CLZ-style comics library and managing photo uploads for eBay listings. It consumes the FastAPI backend that serves the OpenAPI schema at `http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs`.

### hipcomicscraper
An async Python scraper for extracting comic book listings from HipComic marketplace stores. Features a Textual TUI for real-time monitoring, PostgreSQL database storage, and intelligent caching to minimize requests.
